build_TransformerSeq: build a TransformerSeq model with configurable vocab size, hidden size, heads, layers, and attention span
create_SeqAttention: create a SeqAttention layer with optional adaptive span and persistent memory for sequential self-attention
create_MultiHeadSeqAttention: create a MultiHeadSeqAttention module that projects queries, keys, and values across multiple attention heads
create_TransformerSeqLayer: create a TransformerSeqLayer combining multi-head sequential attention with feed-forward and layer normalization
create_FeedForwardLayer: create a FeedForwardLayer with two linear layers and ReLU activation for transformer blocks
